title: T1585.001 — Establish Accounts - Social Media Accounts
subtitle: Follow a fake recruiter persona from creation to payload, with the defender view at every step.
aria: Animation of an attacker creating a fake recruiter profile on a social network, warming it up, connecting with a target employee, moving to email, delivering a file, and the SOC responding.

steps.title: Choosing the identity
steps.caption: The attacker copies a real recruiter's name and photo from an open profile. Or they invent a persona at a real company. Then they pick a target list from public staff pages
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.
